Hot-Blooded.name: Hot-Blooded
Hot-Blooded.description:
🔥 You run hot: loud, passionate and first into any fight or cause.

💪 Your energy lifts the people around you, and teammates push harder beside you.
😤 You come on strong: people feel your anger at injustice before you say a word.
⚠️ Easy to provoke: taunts and insults to friends land hard, and hiding your anger is a hard Willpower check.
⚠️ Waiting quietly on a stakeout or staying polite in a tense negotiation takes visible effort.
🔀 If you are also Calm Under Fire, the heat shows in daily life and drops away in real danger.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Intimidation +5, Leadership +5
Hot-Blooded.traitNarrativeEffects: The character feels everything at full volume: shouted encouragement, a fist on the table, a charge toward trouble, anger at injustice that shows on their face. Teammates feed off that energy and push harder beside them. Weakness: taunts, insults to friends and public humiliation land hard. When someone provokes them on purpose, hiding their anger is a hard Willpower check; on a failure it shows (a raised voice, a sharp reply, a step forward), and what they do next is still the player's choice. Villains, rivals and reporters learn to use this. Waiting quietly on a stakeout or staying polite in a tense negotiation takes visible effort. If the character is also Calm Under Fire, the heat shows in daily life and arguments and drops away in real danger.
